name: Sample mock assessment
models: A short engine sample: a forward-only generated sprint with negative marking, then a mixed paper.
description: A small sample of the mock format, for checking the engine. It is not a real assessment. The first paper runs forward only and marks wrong answers down. The second lets you move freely.

items.title: Two heads
items.question: A fair coin is tossed twice. What is the probability of two heads?

options.why: That is the chance of one head in one toss.
The three outcomes you listed are not equally likely.
That is the chance of at least one head.

feedback.correct: Each toss is a half, and the tosses are independent.
feedback.generic: Multiply the chances of the two tosses.

explain.text: The tosses are independent, so the chance is $\tfrac12 \cdot \tfrac12 = \tfrac14$.

feedback.correct: Ten per cent is 8, and five per cent is 4.
feedback.generic: Find 10% first, then add half of it.

items.title: Up then down
items.question: A price rises by 10%, then falls by 10%. What is the overall change?

options.why: The fall is 10% of a larger price, so it removes more.
The fall is taken from the higher price, not the original.
The rise offsets most of the fall.

explain.text: The factors multiply: $1.1 \times 0.9 = 0.99$, which is a fall of 1%.

parts.name: I kept to a steady pace in the sprint
parts.detail: Aim for about 15 seconds a question or better.
